question: Should OpenClaw establish `auth` as a permanent top-level CLI namespace despite model-provider auth already being owned by `models auth`?
rationale: This is a public command-taxonomy and compatibility choice; source correctness alone cannot determine whether the duplicate namespace is desirable.

options.title: Keep models-owned auth
options.body: Reject the alias and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the only public profile-listing command.

options.title: Sponsor root auth namespace
options.body: Approve a deliberate top-level auth command family, document its long-term scope, and require live proof before merging this entry point.

recommendation.title: Keep models-owned auth
recommendation.body: Reject the alias and retain `openclaw models auth list` as the only public profile-listing command.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged command-boundary work most directly established the current models-owned auth-list contract.
